  "first_3_seconds": "A high-angle shot shows a woman (Prudence) dropping to her knees on a hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in desperate supplication. She pleads loudly: 'He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!' The visual is one of immediate physical desperation and high stakes.",
  "ending": "Lady Juliana has arrived at the sick child's bedside, identified the fever, and commanded Prudence to fetch hot water. The clip cuts exactly as Prudence lifts a steaming kettle from the hearth, leaving the viewer waiting to see if the remedy works.",
  "problems": [
    "The opening scene lacks the specific 'melodramatic punch' (slap, public humiliation, or shocking betrayal) that typically drives vertical drama retention; it relies on emotional pleading which can feel slower to scroll past.",
    "The transition from the barn to the village road happens very quickly without establishing the urgency visually beyond running, which might feel slightly generic compared to more chaotic action hooks.",
    "The ending is a procedural pause (fetching water) rather than a dramatic cliffhanger; the tension is low because the solution seems imminent and safe."
  ],

  "verdict": "maybe",
